page.content:
Three-stage heavy lift rocket that sent Apollo toward the Moon.

How Saturn V connects

  • Faction: Apollo program — Saturn V was the launch vehicle of the Apollo lunar missions.
  • Event: Apollo 11 — Apollo 11 left Earth on a Saturn V from Kennedy Space Center.
  • Character: Wernher von Braun — Wernher von Braun led the Marshall team that built Saturn V.

What is Saturn V?

Saturn V, developed at Marshall under von Braun, remains the tallest rocket NASA has flown. It launched Apollo lunar missions and Skylab from Kennedy's pads.

Key threads lead to Apollo program, Apollo 11 and Wernher von Braun.
